selection_rule: From the frozen prior-disjoint 100-task training cohort, select every task with exactly two distinct training inputs; both leave-one-training-example-out directions. Sort source task IDs only to assign arbitrary fold identifiers. Do not use original test labels.
inference_input: Each fold includes one original training pair plus only the held input; held output is in a separate file supplied solely to the scorer after prediction.
limitations: This is a supplementary intervention cohort; it does not replace the fixed 100-task holdout.
Training exposure from earlier development is not fully audited; the cohort cannot be called unseen.
The 32 folds are correlated pairs from 16 tasks.
